title: The issue of the tilted issue about the household, Princess Marino said this
text:
Friday, 07 February 2025 – 03:07 WIB
Celebrity couple Chicco Jerikho and Putri Marino. Photo: Ricardo
jpnn.com Jakarta – The household of the couple Chicco Jerikho and Putri Marino was rumored to be cracked.
The reason, Princess Marino and Chicco Jerikho are now rarely sharing moments of their togetherness.
Responding to these rumors, Princess Marino claimed to be advised with the unpleasant issue circulating.
“I really understand that there is an issue because me and Chicco rarely take photos posted on social media. Maybe because of that finally many people speculate that the household of me and Chicco have problems,” said Putri Marino in the Dharmawangsa area, South Jakarta, Thursday (6/2).
He admitted, he and his husband also responded casually to the issue. From the rumors circulating, Princess Marino realized that the issue was unpleasant to appear, they rarely uploaded a photo together.
“Finally I told Chicco ‘maybe it may be possible now to post photos’, so that we just tell that we are fine, instead we are more happy now with Suri, with everything,” he said.
Current, both Putri and Chicco more often upload photos of their togetherness.
Putri said, one of the reasons was because she and Chicco were currently in her bucin phases or slave love.
The household of celebrity couple Chicco Jerikho and Putri Marino had been rumored to be cracked.
